data.long_meaning: Biltu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vayu', which means 'God of Wind'. In Hindu mythology, Vayu is one of the eight primary gods and is responsible for the movement of air. The name Biltu is believed to bring the qualities of strength, adaptability, and a connection to the natural world. The name Biltu carries the meaning “God of Wind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biltu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
